verdict.rationale: Secureframe documents that Trust Center data, such as monitoring checks on security controls, is pulled continuously from the platform, so control status updates without manual work. There is no evidence that subprocessor lists or document renewals flow to the Trust Center automatically. Vendor-list auto-detection via SSO is an internal vendor-management feature and is not shown publishing to the Trust Center. Missing for 10: automatic subprocessor list sync to the Trust Center, automated document renewal/expiry updates, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an operations lead, the trust center stays current on its own — subprocessor lists, document renewals, and control status update from the platform, not by hand

citations.quote: Data – like monitoring checks on security controls – is pulled continuously from Secureframe, but admins may choose to hide or display content on their Trust Center.
